caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a dress from the back, predominantly rendered in beige with a faint checkered pattern and small blue and purple floral details scattered throughout the fabric. The dress has long sleeves, a fitted bodice with purple buttons running down the center, and is decorated with purple trim and ruffled accents along the shoulders, bodice, and around the edges of the bottom hem. Along the left side, there are two small square swatches showing close-up sections of the fabric design, one predominantly blue and the other predominantly pink, each with a leaf motif and labeled “exact size.” Above these swatches is a depiction of a round purple button, shown from the front and side, also labeled 'exact size.' On the right side of the drawing, there are two black-and-white line sketches showing different views of the dress, focusing on the design and ruffle placement from the back and angled side. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Dress
